verdict.rationale: VLP's Emerging Growth page says it advises on entity formation, capitalization and equity compensation, and the Executive Compensation page covers stock option and incentive plans with tax issues such as Section 409A. These are adjacent to founder equity but are generic practice-area statements, not materials on the founder mechanics the story names. Missing for 10: any coverage of founder vesting schedules, 83(b) elections, or co-founder equity splits; in-depth founder-equity guidance; independent corroboration.
